usseneti.p: [(u+si+yu=)ussena+i+ti] (kri) Google Translate Na Utsena (iron).] Ascends and ascends.
a: ဥဿေနေတိ(ကြိ)

H: usseneti：[ussena，ussayana 的 denam．] 靠（接）近，親近．

B:
usseneti： usseneti（kri）

P: Usseneti，[denom．fr．ussena = ussayana，ud + śri （?）] to draw on to oneself，to be friendly S．III，89 （v．l．ussi°）； A．II，214 sq．（opp．paṭisseneti）； Ps．II，167 （ussi°）； Kvu I．93 （reading ussineti + visineti）．See also paṭiseneti．（Page 158）
K:

[（ဥ+သိ+ယု=） ဥေဿန+ဣ+တိ။ နာ ဥေဿန（သံ）။]

usseneti：ဥေဿနေတိ （နာ）

DOP: usseneti, ussineti pr. 3 sg. [ prob. denom. from ud + seṇi; perhaps associated with sinoti qv ], forms an association (with); is involved ; S III 89, 23 (pajahati na upādiyati viseneti no usseneti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se ussineti; cf Spk II 296, 23 : vikirati na sampiṇḍeti); A II 214, 32 (bhikkhu n’ ev’ usseneti na ppaṭisseneti; cf Mp III 209, 3 : diṭṭhivasena na ukkhipati); Nidd I 21, 14 (n’ eva visineti na ussineti visinetvā ṭhito, Ee, Se so; Ce n’ eva sineti na ussineti; Be n’ eva saṃsibbati na ussineti; Nidd-a I 89, 25 : mānavasena na ukkaṃsati); Paṭis II 167, 21 (lokaṃ na ussīnentī ti lokuttarā, Be so; Ce, Ee na ussinentī ti; Se nayantī ti; Paṭis-a 621, 35 : na ussīnentī ti na vikiranti … na ussinentī ti rassaṃ katvā pāṭho sundaro); — part.pr. ussinenta, mfn. , Kv 614, 12 (arahā … visinento ussinento); — see also viseneti.
CPD: usseneti , pr. 3 sg. [ denom. of ut + seṇi "associa- tion"; opp. to viseneti ( see BHSD s.v. viśreṇī-katvā); frequent by form ussineti], to associate with, be attached to ( acc. ); ariya-sāvako . . . viseneti no ~ eti, S lll 89, 23 ( v. l. visineti no ussineti; vikirati na sampiṇḍeti, Spk ll 296, 23 ); rūpaṃ + viseneti no ~ eti, S lll 89, 31 foll.; bhikkhu n' ev' ~ eti na ppaṭisseneti, A ll 214, 32 foll. (diṭṭhivasena na ukkhipati, Mp lll 209, 3 ); n' eva visine- ti na ussineti, Nidd l 21, 14 (mānavasena na ukkaṃsati, Nidd-a l 89, 25 ) = 460, 10 = ll 161, 15 ; "lokaṃ visinentī" ti lokuttarā, "lokaṃ na ussinentī" ti lokuttarā, Paṭis ll 167, 21 (na vikiranti na vimuccanti; na ussinentī ti ras- saṃ pāṭho sundaro, Paṭis-a 621, 35 ); arahā n' eva visineti na ussineti visinitvā ṭhito, Kv 93, 21, 24 ; 542, 28 ; 543, 7 ; 614, 21, 25 ; visinento ussinento, 614, 12 .
NCP: pr. 3 sg. forms an association (with); is involved See also: ussineti
